{{Japanese name}} [[File:Pokémon Seminar.png|thumb|250px|[[Friede]] and [[Captain Pikachu]]'s first seminar]] '''Professor Friede's Pokémon Seminar''' (Japanese: '''フリード博士のポケモンゼミ''' ''Friede-hakase no Pokémon Zemi'') is a question-and-answer [[bonus segment]] in {{aniseries|HZ}} that started in [[HZ002]], replacing [[Get Inspired! Let's Solve a Poké Riddle!!]]. Following the initial Japanese airing of the episode, the segments are later uploaded to the official Japanese [https://twitter.com/anipoke_PR Pokémon animated series Twitter] account. For three episodes from [[HZ031]] to [[HZ033]], this segment was replaced by [[Terapagos's Exploration Diary]]. This segment ended in [[HZ088]] and instead is replaced with [[Mega Nidothing's Mega Mega! Mega Evolution]]. The position of the question and answer segments has changed between episodes: * From [[HZ002]] to [[HZ012]], the question is presented for 22 seconds before the post-credits commercial break. The answer is presented for 23 seconds after the post-credits commercial break. * From [[HZ013]] on, the question is presented for 22 seconds before the ending credits.
